## Continuum 0.5.13

### Transfer notifications that stay with you
- **Cleared a transfer's notification by accident? It comes back.** On the computer (GNOME, KDE and others) and on the phone, the progress notification of a file that's still moving reappears within a second if you clear it, dismiss it or tap "Clear all". Always just one, and it turns into "Sent…" or "Received…" when the transfer is done.
- **The speed you see is the real speed right now.** Both the computer and the phone now measure the last few seconds of the transfer, so the number follows your Wi-Fi as it speeds up or slows down. If a transfer stalls, the speed disappears instead of showing an old figure. Resumed transfers no longer show a made-up speed for the part that was already there. The same number appears in the app's transfers button.

### Fixes
- **Pairing back with a computer you used before works.** If you paired the phone with another computer and then scanned a new code from the first one, the pairing was dropped without a word (you had to remove the phone on the computer first). It now pairs straight away.
- **The share sheet only offers the computer you're paired with.** After switching to a new computer, the old one could still show up as "Send to <old computer>".

Update both the computer and the phone to get all of this.

Google Play Protect may ask to scan the app, because it isn't from the Play Store. Tap **Scan app**, then **Install**.
